notes.title: Hardcore update
Scroll the screen in the resolution of 1280x1024 (5: 4) and display achievements
notes.content:
Bugs fixed:
[*] With the resolution of the game 1280x1024 (5: 4), the screen did not scroll when moving to the next block horizontally.
[*] Achievements were not shown immediately after receipt, but only when the game was closed.

notes.title: The first update.
notes.content: Fixed bugs with sound and control
